about: The allow-list of the request to forget "boiler-forget 1": what a Hub sends by itself when its owner chooses "Wis wat ik heb gedeeld" ("Delete what I shared"). Exactly four members and nothing else: a key that is not listed makes the whole request invalid. The reference (report_id) and the installation's code (tester_code) are the values of the bundle the Hub sent; the intake deletes only when BOTH belong to the same stored report. The member names are the ones the receiver on the website checks (archive/website/ontvanger/fields.json).
